facts.raw_span: a 3-month history of brown-yellowish vaginal discharge
fluctuating lower abdominal pain
fever
progressive abdominal enlargement over 15 years, worsening in the last 5 years
difficulty with defecation and voiding
a smooth, firm pelvic mass was palpated extending to two fingers below the umbilicus, with limited mobility
the cervix could not be visualized or sondaged
elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level of 115.6 g/dL
a 269 × 529 mm hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity
a separate 126 × 106 mm homogeneous solid mass in the left adnexa with a clear border
a 145 × 110 × 146 mm multilocular cystic mass with thick septa and enhancing solid components
no lymphadenopathy was noted

concepts.why: The patient has a history of progressive abdominal enlargement and a smooth, firm pelvic mass was palpated, which is consistent with a uterine leiomyoma.
The patient presents with fever, fluctuating lower abdominal pain, and a pelvic mass, which is consistent with an infected hematometra.
The patient has a separate solid mass in the left adnexa with a clear border, which is consistent with an ovarian fibroma.
The patient has an elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level and a multilocular cystic mass with thick septa and enhancing solid components, which is consistent with uterine cancer.
The patient has a history of progressive abdominal enlargement, difficulty with defecation and voiding, and a smooth, firm pelvic mass, which is consistent with adenomyosis.
